array.string: set -euo pipefail TOKEN_FILE="$HOME/.hermes/secrets/od_api_token" if [ ! -f "$TOKEN_FILE" ]; then echo "opendesign: missing token file $TOKEN_FILE" >&2 exit 78 fi PERMS=$(/usr/bin/stat -f '%Lp' "$TOKEN_FILE") if [ "$PERMS" != "600" ]; then echo "opendesign: $TOKEN_FILE must be mode 0600 (found 0$PERMS)" >&2 exit 78 fi OD_API_TOKEN=$(/usr/bin/head -n 1 "$TOKEN_FILE" | /usr/bin/tr -d '\r\n') if [ -z "$OD_API_TOKEN" ]; then echo "opendesign: $TOKEN_FILE is empty" >&2 exit 78 fi export OD_API_TOKEN NODE_BIN="" for candidate in "$HOME/opt/node24/bin/node" /opt/homebrew/bin/node /usr/local/bin/node; do if [ -x "$candidate" ]; then NODE_BIN="$candidate" break fi done if [ -z "$NODE_BIN" ]; then echo "opendesign: no node runtime found" >&2 exit 78 fi OD_ENTRY="/Users/colingreig/opendesign/apps/daemon/bin/od.mjs" if [ ! -f "$OD_ENTRY" ]; then echo "opendesign: daemon entry $OD_ENTRY not found" >&2 exit 78 fi /bin/mkdir -p "$OD_DATA_DIR" echo "opendesign: starting $NODE_BIN $OD_ENTRY daemon start --headless" exec "$NODE_BIN" "$OD_ENTRY" daemon start --headless
